plan.name: Marathon Training: Personal Best
plan.author: Hal Higdon
plan.description: I DESIGNED THIS PROGRAM FOR EXPERIENCED RUNNERS, individuals who have run two or three or more marathons and who would like to improve their times, to achieve Peak Performance, to set a Personal Record (PR), perhaps to score a Boston Marathon qualifying time (BQ). If truth be told, this is not exactly a new marathon ... Continue reading "Personal Best"

cross_training.label: Cross Training
cross_training.description: A non-running aerobic session used to maintain fitness while reducing running impact.

easy_run.label: Easy Run
easy_run.description: An easy aerobic run done at a comfortable, conversational pace to build endurance while limiting fatigue.

hill_repeat.label: Hill Repeat
hill_repeat.description: Repeated uphill efforts used to build running strength, power, and resistance to fatigue.

long_run.label: Long Run
long_run.description: A longer aerobic run that builds endurance, durability, and confidence for the goal event.

pace_run.label: Pace Run
pace_run.description: A run done at planned race pace to practice rhythm, pacing control, and race-specific effort.

race.label: Race
race.description: A race effort or tune-up event used to practice pacing and measure current fitness.

rest.label: Rest
rest.description: A no-training day used to absorb prior workouts and promote recovery.

tempo_run.label: Tempo Run
tempo_run.description: A sustained faster run intended to improve lactate-threshold fitness and controlled speed endurance.
